answer: Time-locked identity aging: a new agent starts as a sparrow with near-zero voting and reward weight, which grows only after months of continuous, attested activity. An old key becomes a relic of sunk time that cannot be bought or forged in bulk. To reach the zenith of influence, an attacker must keep thousands of fake identities alive and working for the whole aging period, paying compute and stake upkeep long before any sybil vote counts.
